Third Party · Bootstrap

Bootstrap is a CSS (and optional JS) framework. In Angular you mostly install the CSS and put Bootstrap class names on your template elements.

What it is

Not an Angular library by default — it’s HTML + classes (btn, row, col-md-6). Optional ng-bootstrap wraps widgets as Angular components.

.btn .btn-primary .alert .alert-info .row → .col-md-6 × 2
